remediation.suggestion: Use clearer placeholders such as $PROJECT_ROOT/output/... or explain that paths must stay inside the project workspace.

remediation.issue: Large fenced examples contain many inline code markers that can create noisy static findings.
remediation.suggestion: Keep examples concise or separate executable commands from report examples to reduce audit noise.

content.value_statement: Chapter generation pipelines need clear evidence before deployment. This skill turns validation artifacts into readable reports, metrics, and approval guidance.
actual_capabilities: Collects structure, semantic, consolidation, and chapter HTML validation artifacts.
Calculates quality scores, compliance percentages, completeness estimates, and content metrics.
Generates a human-readable verification report for stakeholder review.
Produces machine-readable quality metrics for CI/CD and dashboards.
Documents deployment recommendations based on validation outcomes.
Summarizes CSS class usage, content structure, issues, and next steps.
limitations: Requires prior validation artifacts from earlier quality gates.
Does not perform the visual accuracy check itself.
Depends on accurate chapter metadata and artifact paths.
Example metrics must be adapted to the real chapter being reviewed.

use_cases.title: Approve chapter deployment
use_cases.description: Create final evidence that a generated chapter passed validation and is ready for release.

use_cases.title: Feed quality dashboards
use_cases.description: Produce structured metrics that CI/CD systems can parse for automated decisions and trend tracking.

use_cases.title: Review generation quality
use_cases.description: Summarize validation results, content counts, and known issues for manual review.

prompt_templates.title: Create a basic report
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the quality-report-generate skill to create a verification report for chapter 2 using the available validation artifacts.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize deployment readiness
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request focused on approval status.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate the chapter quality report and highlight whether the chapter is ready for deployment, needs review, or requires fixes.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare CI/CD metrics
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the quality report workflow to produce machine-readable quality metrics for CI/CD and explain the pass or fail criteria.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a full chapter package
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review with all validation inputs.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create the final quality report from structure validation, semantic validation, consolidation logs, and chapter HTML. Include risks, recommendations, and stakeholder summary.

output_examples.input: Generate a quality report for chapter 2 after validation gates finish.
output_examples.output: A verification report with quality score, validation status, content summary, findings, and a deployment recommendation.

output_examples.input: Create CI metrics for a chapter build.
output_examples.output: A metrics summary showing overall status, validation pass counts, content totals, completeness, and readiness for deployment automation.

output_examples.input: Review a chapter that has warnings but no errors.
output_examples.output: A report that separates passed checks from warnings and recommends manual review before release.

best_practices: Run structure and semantic validation before generating the final report.
Verify artifact paths and chapter numbers before producing deployment evidence.
Review both the markdown report and JSON metrics before approving release.
anti_patterns: Do not use placeholder scores as final deployment evidence.
Do not generate the report before validation artifacts are complete.
Do not treat this skill as a replacement for visual accuracy validation.

faq.question: What does this skill generate?
faq.answer: It generates a chapter verification report and quality metrics for deployment review.

faq.question: Does it validate HTML structure directly?
faq.answer: It aggregates structure validation results from earlier gates and reports their status.

faq.question: Can CI/CD systems use the output?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill defines machine-readable quality metrics for automated tracking and deployment decisions.

faq.question: Does it perform visual comparison with source PDFs?
faq.answer: No. It can include visual accuracy results when those results already exist.

faq.question: What inputs are required?
faq.answer: It expects validation reports, consolidation logs, and the final chapter HTML file.

faq.question: Who should use this skill?
faq.answer: Content reviewers, DevOps engineers, and documentation teams can use it for chapter release evidence.
